## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build:lint` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] Permissions unchanged (`storage`, `activeTab`, hosts `x.com` and `twitter.com` only); if not, explain why above
- [ ] Privacy rules kept: no new network requests, no telemetry, no reading of cookies, tokens or account data, nothing saved from private windows
- [ ] No new `innerHTML`, `eval` or remote code; no new runtime dependency
- [ ] Workflow changes: third-party actions pinned by full commit SHA, `permissions` minimal, no `pull_request_target`, no secrets in pull request workflows
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-facing
